result.stdout:
Description:
  pefix is a single-binary CLI that diagnoses and (selectively) repairs .NET assembly portability and load-failure issues.
  
  Run `pefix <verb> --help` for verb-specific options.
  
  Exit codes:
    0  Success or no gate triggered
    1  Failure-on-gate triggered, refusal, or non-compatible result
    2  Usage error
    4  IO error

Usage:
  pefix [command] [options]

Options:
  --json          Write structured JSON output.
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  inspect <path>    Inspects a single managed assembly.
  scan <path>       Scans a directory of managed assemblies for portability and integrity issues.
  fix <path>        Apply the safe PE header fix. Defaults to dry-run; pass --apply to write.
  snstrip <path>    Strip strong-name signing. Defaults to dry-run; pass --apply to write.
  redir <path>      Rewrite AssemblyRef version fields. Defaults to dry-run; pass --apply to write.
  pinvoke <path>    List P/Invoke calls in a managed assembly or directory.
  publicize <path>  Publicize types/methods/fields in a managed assembly. Default dry-run; pass --apply to write.

result.stdout:
Description:
  Apply the safe PE header fix. Defaults to dry-run; pass --apply to write.

Usage:
  pefix fix <path> [options]

Arguments:
  <path>  Assembly file or directory to fix.

Options:
  --apply         Write changes to disk. Without this flag, the command only reports what would change.
  --no-backup     Skip .bak file creation. Only meaningful with --apply.
  --force         Allow patching cautioned assemblies. Only meaningful with --apply.
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --json          Write structured JSON output.
